scope: Visual inspection of the captured scenes only; not full production or aesthetic acceptance
client: Official unmodified Minecraft 1.21.11 / Xvfb / software OpenGL

observations.dome: Closed spherical honeycomb visible from outside; no missing-model cube
observations.vanilla_blocks: Placed copper block and redstone torch have normal sprites
observations.fuel: The four bottles move from the player inventory into input slot 0; native assertions verify stock and empty cursor
observations.hud: Private text and heart icon are visible, with a plain public vanilla dragon bar; server checks privacy for the other player
observations.beam_warning: Circular location markers visible before firing
observations.beam_active: Dark vertical columns and violet edge glow visible; all 151 server models verified
observations.beam_fade: Harmless fade/shrink stage captured; removal verified on the server

limits: Far dark column surfaces remain subtle; aesthetic preference is not an automated pass criterion
Green/yellow variants, full 30-second dome expiry and camera movement are not separately certified by these still frames
No FPS/TPS benchmark or integration run with the users entire plugin set
